properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 19 at 12:59PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
At 1259 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm
capable of producing a landspout 28 miles southwest of Grand
Junction, moving northeast at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Landspouts, wind gusts up to 40 mph, and nickel size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to outdoor objects is possible. Gusty winds
could knock down tree limbs and blow around unsecured
objects.

This storm will remain over mainly rural areas of southwestern Mesa
County.

This includes Colorado 141 between mile markers 126 and 136.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 19 at 12:58PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 1258 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong
thunderstorms extending from near Arapahoe Park to near Franktown, or
extending from 14 miles east of Denver to 28 miles southeast of
Denver, moving east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Southeastern Aurora, eastern Centennial, Parker, Bennett,
Elizabeth, Kiowa, Ponderosa Park, Arapahoe Park, The Pinery,
Franktown, Buckley SFB, Strasburg and Castlewood Canyon.
